$comment: The Python tests the gated suite (npm run test:python:gate) is ALLOWED to skip,
keyed by unittest test id. Read by pipeline/jobfit/tests/run_gated.py, which
ci.yml runs in the python-gate job. The rules live in that module's
evaluate_skips / register_problems; the short version:
A SKIP NOT NAMED HERE fails the run BY NAME, even when the skip count is
unchanged. An `always` entry that RAN fails the run as stale, with the edit
that retires it. An `env-conditional` entry that ran is a note: it skips only
where its `condition` holds (CI) and runs in a full checkout.
THE LENGTH OF THIS LIST MUST EQUAL KP_SKIP_BASELINE in .github/workflows/ci.yml,
and exactly ENV_CONDITIONAL_SKIPS (run_gated.py) entries are env-conditional.
So tolerating a new skip takes an entry here AND a raised baseline, which the
review:constitution lens blocks (skip-baseline-raised). That is deliberate:
fix the cause instead. Checked BEFORE the suite runs: an id no discovered test
has (dead), a `why` under 20 characters (unexplained), a duplicate id, a
`when` outside always | env-conditional.
AN ENTRY IS:
id         the unittest id: pipeline.jobfit.tests.<module>.<Class>.<method>
when       always | env-conditional
condition  what makes it skip, as the skip site states it
why        why skipping it is tolerated rather than fixed

skips.condition: skipUnless KP_CLAUDE_CLI_LIVE=1, which CI never sets (its inner `claude CLI not on PATH` skip is unreachable behind it)
skips.why: A live call to the real Claude CLI: it spends a subscription and needs a logged-in CLI, so it is opt-in by design and never part of a keyless run.

skips.condition: skipUnless the personal CV fixture linkedin-profile.pdf exists
skips.why: The fixture is a real person's CV and is intentionally not committed; the synthetic letter-spaced fixture covers the extraction path in every run.

skips.condition: skipUnless the personal CV fixture technical-cv.pdf exists
skips.why: The fixture is a real person's CV and is intentionally not committed; test_pypdf_collapses_letter_spaced_text pins the same collapse on a synthetic fixture.

skips.condition: skipUnless technical-cv.pdf exists AND GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY is set
skips.why: Needs the uncommitted personal CV fixture and a paid Gemini key; CI has neither, and a keyless run must not spend money.
